name: Llançà (Spain)
description: White field with a dark blue wavy lower part of three and a half crests, from which rise three red lances with blue heads.
history: The flag was approved on 14 April 2006 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 4377 of 4 May 2006; it is based on the arms, an oblong flag of 2:3, white, with a dark blue part along the lower edge waved with three and a half crests, 3/11 of the height at the hoist and fly edges and 7/22 at the crests.

features.role: wavy division of three and a half crests
three lances rising from the waves
